data.title: 莲华 · 万华镜前的青烟萦绕
data.description: 昏暗的和室中央，鎏金的万华镜静静散发着幽微的光芒。莲华斜倚在朱红色的榻榻米案几旁，指尖拈着青铜烟管轻吐出一缕薄雾，赤瞳在袅袅青烟后带着看透一切的戏谑浅笑。
data.location: dim shadowy ryokan tatami chamber with antique brass kaleidoscope on lacquer table
data.action: reclining elegantly on crimson velvet cushion, exhaling a graceful trail of smoke from kiseru pipe, piercing red eyes gleaming with amused mystery
data.lighting: warm flickering paper lantern and glowing kaleidoscope gems casting jewel patterns
data.mood: intoxicating traditional mystery, sultry enigmatic allure, mesmerizing gothic Japanese elegance
data.promptProse: Lounging on tatami in a rich vermilion kimono, Renge blows scented curls of smoke from her pipe, watching through mysterious ruby eyes.
data.animaCaption: Renge smoking her slender kiseru pipe beside an ornate kaleidoscope on tatami.
